### Repeated Measures, MANOVA, and Discriminant Analysis in R

This project combines repeated-measures and multivariate statistical analysis in R. It examines changes in self-esteem across treatment groups over time and uses MANOVA and discriminant analysis to distinguish rainforest leaves from different regions based on multiple shape measurements.

**Tools:** R, repeated-measures MANOVA, mixed-effects model, MANOVA, discriminant analysis

### Canadian Mortgage Loan Value Analysis

Analysis of how average new mortgage loan values changed across Canada, provinces, and selected metropolitan areas from 2012 Q3 to 2025 Q4, using descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, bootstrapping, and regression modelling to examine the effects of time and geography.

**Tools:** R, readxl, tidyverse, dplyr, tidyr, lubridate, janitor, ggplot2, confidence intervals, Welch two-sample t-test, bootstrap resampling, linear regression, interaction regression, cross-validation

[View Project](mortgage_canada_data.html)
:::
:::

### Cluster Analysis of Amino Acid Sequencing and Exoplanets

Clustering analysis of vertebrate genetic distances and exoplanet characteristics using hierarchical clustering with Ward's method, dendrogram interpretation, z-score standardization, scree plots, and K-means cluster comparison.

**Tools:** R, tidyverse, dplyr, tidyr, readr, hclust, Ward's method, dendrograms, rect.hclust, dist objects, scale, K-means clustering, set.seed, nstart, scree plot, within-cluster sum of squares

[View Project](amino_acid_exoplanet_analysis.html)
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('star-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W, H, nodes, rings, frame = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
    H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    init();
  }

  const N = 72;
  const CONNECT_DIST = 140;
  const PULSE_INTERVAL = 80;

  function gaussRand() {
    let u = 0, v = 0;
    while (u === 0) u = Math.random();
    while (v === 0) v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  const clusterColors = [
    { r: 80,  g: 60,  b: 200 },
    { r: 40,  g: 100, b: 210 },
    { r: 120, g: 120, b: 140 },
  ];

  function init() {
    rings = [];
    nodes = Array.from({ length: N }, (_, i) => {
      const cluster = i % 3;
      const cx = [W * .20, W * .52, W * .80][cluster];
      const cy = [H * .52, H * .42, H * .56][cluster];
      const spread = [W * .11, W * .13, W * .10][cluster];
      return {
        x: cx + gaussRand() * spread,
        y: cy + gaussRand() * spread * 0.6,
        vx: (Math.random() - .5) * 0.22,
        vy: (Math.random() - .5) * 0.14,
        r: 1.8 + Math.random() * 2.8,
        baseAlpha: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.45,
        pulse: 0,
        breathOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        breathSpeed: 0.016 + Math.random() * 0.014,
        cluster
      };
    });
  }

  function spawnRing(x, y, col) {
    rings.push({ x, y, col, r: 4, maxR: 60 + Math.random() * 40, alpha: 0.6, speed: 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.6 });
  }

  function drawRings() {
    rings = rings.filter(rg => rg.alpha > 0.01);
    rings.forEach(rg => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(rg.x, rg.y, rg.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rg.col.r},${rg.col.g},${rg.col.b},${rg.alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx.stroke();
      rg.r += rg.speed;
      rg.alpha *= 0.94;
    });
  }

  function drawFlow() {
    const t = frame * 0.008;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 28) {
      for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 28) {
        const angle = Math.sin(x * 0.012 + t) * Math.cos(y * 0.012 + t * 0.7) * Math.PI * 2;
        const len = 7;
        const ax = x + Math.cos(angle) * len * 0.5;
        const ay = y + Math.sin(angle) * len * 0.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ax - Math.cos(angle) * len * 0.5, ay - Math.sin(angle) * len * 0.5);
        ctx.lineTo(ax + Math.cos(angle) * len * 0.5, ay + Math.sin(angle) * len * 0.5);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100,110,180,0.07)`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawFlow();
    drawRings();

    if (frame % PULSE_INTERVAL === 0) {
      const src = nodes[Math.floor(Math.random() * N)];
      src.pulse = 1;
      spawnRing(src.x, src.y, clusterColors[src.cluster]);
      setTimeout(() => spawnRing(src.x, src.y, clusterColors[src.cluster]), 180);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const a = nodes[i];
      for (let j = i + 1; j < N; j++) {
        const b = nodes[j];
        const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
        const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (d < CONNECT_DIST) {
          const strength = 1 - d / CONNECT_DIST;
          const pulseBoost = Math.max(a.pulse, b.pulse);
          const ca = clusterColors[a.cluster];
          const cb = clusterColors[b.cluster];
          const mr = Math.round((ca.r + cb.r) / 2);
          const mg = Math.round((ca.g + cb.g) / 2);
          const mb = Math.round((ca.b + cb.b) / 2);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
          ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${mr},${mg},${mb},${(strength * 0.22 + pulseBoost * 0.5).toFixed(3)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.4 + strength * 1.4 + pulseBoost * 1.8;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    nodes.forEach(n => {
      const col = clusterColors[n.cluster];
      const breathe = 0.82 + 0.18 * Math.sin(frame * n.breathSpeed + n.breathOffset);
      const a = Math.min(1, n.baseAlpha * breathe + n.pulse * 0.5);
      const radius = (n.r + n.pulse * 4) * breathe;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col.r},${col.g},${col.b},${a.toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, radius + 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${col.r},${col.g},${col.b},${(a * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();

      if (n.pulse > 0.01) {
        n.pulse = Math.max(0, n.pulse - 0.02);
      }

      n.x += n.vx;
      n.y += n.vy;
      const pad = 24;
      if (n.x < pad || n.x > W - pad) n.vx *= -1;
      if (n.y < pad || n.y > H - pad) n.vy *= -1;
      n.x = Math.max(pad, Math.min(W - pad, n.x));
      n.y = Math.max(pad, Math.min(H - pad, n.y));
    });

    frame++;
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  resize();
  draw();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
})();
</script>
```
